name: Superman
hook: The Man of Steel: kryptonite, Lois Lane and the many faces of Clark Kent.

facts.label: kryptonite
facts.statement: Kryptonite first appeared in a 1943 Adventures of Superman radio show; when it reached the comics in 1949 it was red, not green.

facts.label: Metropolis, Illinois
facts.statement: Metropolis, at the tip of Illinois, has a Superman statue, a casino and a multi-day Superman celebration.

facts.label: Lois Lane
facts.statement: Lois Lane is the Daily Planet reporter played by Margot Kidder in Superman II; Papa John's once gave free pizzas to anyone on a street named Lois Lane.

facts.label: Christopher Reeve
facts.statement: Christopher Reeve played Superman in the 1978 film after rooming with Robin Williams at Juilliard; he had earlier played 'Superman' on Love of Life.

facts.label: George Reeves
facts.statement: George Reeves played TV's Superman in the 1950s; his mysterious death inspired the film Hollywoodland.

facts.label: Lex Luthor
facts.statement: Lex Luthor is Superman's bald arch-villain, played by Gene Hackman in the 1978 film and obsessed with Superman since Action Comics No. 23 in 1940.

facts.label: Smallville
facts.statement: Smallville is the TV series where Lois and Clark marry and Clark finally wears the suit to save Lois aboard Air Force One; Remy Zero's 'Save Me' is its theme.
